findings.summary: spi net /AT25_MISO crosses GND plane gap
findings.description: spi signal /AT25_MISO crosses a gap in GND plane on layer F.Cu.
findings.recommendation: Re-route /AT25_MISO to avoid the GND plane gap, or bridge with a stitching capacitor.

report_context.impact: Increased EMI from enlarged return path loop

findings.recommendation: Bridge the plane gap with copper pour or stitching vias. If zones were modified after the last fill, run KiCad Edit → Fill All Zones (B) and re-run the analyzer first — stale zone fills are a common cause of apparent plane splits.

report_context.impact: Return path discontinuity increases EMI

findings.summary: GND plane split: 4 islands, 12 signals crossing
findings.description: GND plane has 4 disconnected islands. Signals crossing: /SCL, /SDA, /AT25_nCS, /AT25_MISO, /AT25_MOSI.
findings.recommendation: Bridge the plane gap with copper pour or stitching vias. If zones were modified after the last fill, run KiCad Edit → Fill All Zones (B) and re-run the analyzer first — stale zone fills are a common cause of apparent plane splits.

report_context.impact: Return path discontinuity increases EMI
